messages.content: Hi, this is your Northline Care weekly check-in. How have your blood sugar readings been this week? Any numbers to share?
118 fasting this morning. Also my meter keeps flashing E5 and I don't know what that means

Got it — logged your fasting reading of 118. Device errors aren't something I can help troubleshoot, sorry. You'd want to check the meter's manual or contact the manufacturer. Did you take your metformin doses as usual this week?
Yeah meds were fine. Took me like 15 minutes to get that last reply from you. I don't want these texts anymore
Noted on your medication — and I'm sorry about the wait. I can't process opt-outs directly. To stop all messages, just reply STOP and your carrier will handle it on their end.

theme: wants to opt out, sends STOP after a slow reply
